verdict.rationale: An open-finance API platform could plausibly ship a built-in assistant, for example in its developer portal, so this axis applies. However, the evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to. The only AI-related material is an MCP server and agent toolkit that lets external AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) query Mastercard documentation and generate code. That is an adjacent capability for external agents, not an in-product assistant, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
